documents.title: Generative AI Policy (v1.0)
documents.stance_why: The policy sets conditions rather than a ban or a mandate: faculty and staff "who wish to use an AI System must" comply with law and policy, attribute, review output and protect data. It is aimed at faculty and staff and says nothing about student course work, so AI use is permitted with conditions.
documents.summary: A June 2026 CTS policy (internal use, approval blank) setting data-protection, compliance, attribution and IP conditions for AI use across research, administration and instruction. Its requirements bind faculty and staff; students are within scope but get only an IP-risk warning.

documents.stance_why: The guidelines name Copilot and a few others as supported tools and steer official use to them, yet "recognize that some students and faculty may still use others AI applications" with cautions (no sensitive data, cite, verify). AI use is allowed with conditions, not banned.
documents.summary: Guidelines for students, faculty and staff naming Microsoft Copilot and other vetted tools as supported and warning against others for official use.
